  defect densities are expected to drop linearly from 1.5 defects/cm2 to 0.8 defects/

  A)      the cost of 8-inch wafer production will fall linearly from \$10,000 to \$6,500. Assume   (5)  
  production of good devices is constant in each year. Which production process should be  
  chosen?

  during pipelining?                                                                     (2)
